title: Fairness trade-offs in expert evaluation: information, judgment, and procedural design
title_zh: 专家评价中的公平性权衡：信息、判断与程序设计
title_primary: 专家评价中的公平性权衡：信息、判断与程序设计
title_secondary: Fairness trade-offs in expert evaluation: information, judgment, and procedural design
authors: Borowiecki, Karol J., Law, Marc T.
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Evaluation systems often seek to reduce bias, prevent manipulation, preserve relevant information, maintain comparability, and treat candidates equally, but these fairness goals can conflict. This paper develops a framework for understanding such trade-offs in expert evaluation—including peer review, grant panels, academic hiring, and artistic competitions—where quality is multidimensional and legitimate disagreement among evaluators is possible. We treat the choice among evaluation procedures as a problem of constitutional design: rules must be selected before the specific candidates, evaluators, and circumstances that will test them are known. Classical music competitions are our primary analytical setting because their rules, scores, and controversies make these trade-offs unusually visible, but the framework applies to other settings in which expert judgments are aggregated under incomplete information. The framework highlights two core tensions: information control and outlier rules. First, when information is both quality-relevant and identity-revealing, procedures that suppress bias-relevant cues may also remove information with genuine evaluative content. Second, because sincere minority judgment and strategic manipulation can generate similar observed score patterns, score-based exclusion rules may reduce manipulation while limiting legitimate dissent. Two further trade-offs concerning transparency and standardization are developed as illustrations. The analysis shows that no procedure can eliminate all vulnerabilities at once. Beyond this design implication, the framework also helps explain why evaluation rules differ across stages and settings, and why well-intentioned reforms may create new vulnerabilities.
abstract_zh: 评估体系往往力求减少偏见、防止操纵、保留相关信息、维持可比性并平等对待候选人，但这些公平目标之间可能相互冲突。本文构建了一个框架，用以理解专家评估中的此类权衡——包括同行评审、资助评审小组、学术招聘和艺术竞赛——在这些场景中，质量是多维度的，且评审者之间存在合理的意见分歧。我们将评估程序的选择视为一项宪法设计问题：规则必须在具体候选人、评审者及可能检验这些规则的情境被知晓之前选定。古典音乐比赛是我们的主要分析场景，因为其规则、评分和争议使这些权衡异常清晰可见，但该框架同样适用于其他在信息不完整条件下汇总专家判断的情境。该框架突出了两个核心张力：信息控制与离群值规则。首先，当信息既与质量相关又揭示身份时，抑制偏见相关线索的程序也可能移除具有真实评价内容的信息。其次，由于真诚的少数派判断与策略性操纵可能产生相似的观察得分模式，基于得分的排除规则可能在减少操纵的同时限制合法的异议。另外两个关于透明度和标准化的权衡作为示例加以阐述。分析表明，没有任何程序能同时消除所有脆弱性。除这一设计启示外，该框架还有助于解释为何评估规则在不同阶段和情境中存在差异，以及为何出于善意的改革可能引发新的脆弱性。

abstract: We study monopolistic certification in markets where sellers possess partial private information about product quality. A certifier can provide information through two channels: screening sellers’ private information (soft information) and acquiring new quality data (hard information). We prove that any certification menu achieving less than maximal screening is Pareto dominated by one with full screening.

title_zh: 自由贸易 vs. 战略贸易：窥探潘多拉之盒
title_primary: 自由贸易 vs. 战略贸易：窥探潘多拉之盒
title_secondary: Free Trade Vs. Strategic Trade: A Peek into Pandora's Box
authors: Gene M. Grossman, Giovanni Maggi
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2007-10-24 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We investigate whether a welfare-maximizing government ought to pursue a programme of strategic trade intervention or instead commit itself to free trade when, in the former case, domestic firms will have an opportunity to manipulate the government’s choice of the level of intervention. Domestic firms may over-invest in physical and knowledge capital in a regime of strategic intervention in order to influence the government’s choice of subsidy. In the event, a commitment to free trade may be desirable even in settings where profit-shifting would be possible. We analyse the desirability of such a commitment when the government is well informed about firms’ types and actions, and when it suffers from an informational disadvantage.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨在以下情境中，追求社会福利最大化的政府是否应实施战略性贸易干预政策，抑或应承诺自由贸易：在前一种情形下，国内企业将有机会操纵政府对干预水平的选择。在战略性干预体制下，国内企业可能过度投资于物质资本和知识资本，以影响政府对补贴水平的决策。因此，即便存在利润转移的可能性，承诺自由贸易仍可能是可取的选择。我们分析了政府在充分了解企业类型与行为，以及面临信息劣势时，此类承诺的合意性。

title: Asymmetric Pass‐Through and Competition
title_zh: 非对称传导与竞争
title_primary: 非对称传导与竞争
title_secondary: Asymmetric Pass‐Through and Competition
authors: Christos Genakos, Yuan Lyu, Mario Pagliero
official: 官方在线 2026-07-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We study the retail price pass‐through of four major tax changes in petroleum products using daily pricing data from gas stations on small Greek islands. We find that (i) the pass‐through of the tax hikes is five times higher than for the tax decrease, (ii) the pass‐through of the tax hikes increases with competition, while that of the tax decrease does not, (iii) there is significant asymmetry in the speed of price adjustments, and (iv) the asymmetric price adjustment can be rationalized by either tacit collusion or consumer search behavior, as the most plausible explanations.
abstract_zh: 我们利用希腊小岛上加油站的每日定价数据，研究了石油产品四次重大税收变动的零售价格传导效应。研究发现：（i）税收上调的传导效应是税收下调的五倍；（ii）税收上调的传导效应随竞争程度增强而提高，而税收下调的传导效应则不受竞争影响；（iii）价格调整速度存在显著的不对称性；（iv）这种不对称价格调整最合理的解释是默契合谋或消费者搜寻行为。

title: Informal coastal reclamation driven by monitoring and enforcement gaps: from plans to practice in a protected lagoon
title_zh: 监测与执法缺口驱动的非正式海岸围垦：从规划到实践——以某受保护泻湖为例
title_primary: 监测与执法缺口驱动的非正式海岸围垦：从规划到实践——以某受保护泻湖为例
title_secondary: Informal coastal reclamation driven by monitoring and enforcement gaps: from plans to practice in a protected lagoon
authors: Patryk Sitkiewicz, Bartosz Płóciennik, Monika Michałek, Anastazja Mastylak, Shasha Liu 等
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-18 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Coastal zones increasingly face conflicts as societal demands, economic development, including tourism, and nature conservation compete for limited coastal space. Although lagoon coasts are ecologically valuable and morphologically stable, these remain especially vulnerable to incremental, tourism-driven land-use changes. Fragmented spatial monitoring allows many of these small-scale alterations to escape detection, undermining enforcement and the implementation of coastal plans. This study analyses long-term shoreline and land-use changes (1976–2024) across eight independent campgrounds located along a Natura 2000-designated protected lagoon coast in the southern Baltic Sea. It provides the systematic documentation of informal coastal reclamation associated with the expansion of privately leased campground areas within legally protected zones. These unpermitted modifications led to substantial shoreline progradation (up to 60 m) and cumulative land gains, effectively transforming the spatial structure of the coast beyond authorised boundaries. A six-stage model of campground expansion is introduced to explain how tourism-driven pressures, combined with monitoring and enforcement gaps, enable gradual but extensive land-use transformation. The results reveal a governance paradox in which extensive monitoring data and formal protection frameworks coexisted with ineffective enforcement, regulatory loopholes, and institutional fragmentation. This exposed a critical implementation gap between existing land-use plans and their practical enforcement, offering an analytical framework transferable to similar coastal governance contexts worldwide. The study highlights the need for scalable spatial monitoring tools and cross-institutional coordination to ensure that coastal management frameworks effectively translate formal protection into practice. abstract_zh: 沿海地区因社会需求、经济发展（包括旅游业）与自然保护对有限海岸空间的竞争而日益面临冲突。尽管泻湖海岸在生态上具有重要价值且形态稳定，但这些区域尤其容易受到由旅游业驱动的渐进式土地利用变化的影响。碎片化的空间监测使得许多此类小规模改变得以逃脱检测，削弱了执法力度及海岸规划的实施。本研究分析了位于波罗的海南部一处Natura 2000指定保护泻湖海岸沿线八个独立露营地的长期岸线及土地利用变化（1976-2024年）。研究系统记录了与法律保护区内私人租赁露营地扩张相关的非正式海岸开垦情况。这些未经许可的改造导致了显著的岸线推进（最大达60米）及累积性土地增益，实际上改变了海岸的空间结构，超出了授权边界。研究引入了一个六阶段露营地扩张模型，用以解释旅游业驱动压力与监测及执法缺口相结合，如何促成渐进但大规模的土地利用转变。研究结果揭示了一种治理悖论：广泛的监测数据与正式保护框架并存，但执法不力、监管漏洞及制度碎片化同时存在。这暴露了现有土地利用规划与其实际执行之间的关键实施差距，提供了一个可推广至全球类似海岸治理情境的分析框架。研究强调了可扩展空间监测工具及跨机构协调的必要性，以确保海岸管理框架能有效将正式保护转化为实际行动。图形摘要 下载：下载高分辨率图片（269KB） 下载：下载全尺寸图片

authors: Germain Gaudin
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study quality distortions when firms hold market power. We develop a model allowing for flexible functional forms of demand in order to extend Spence’s (1975) monopoly analysis to imperfect competition. We show that quality distortions are determined by a competition effect that captures the externality a firm exerts on its competitors when raising both its price and its quality, in addition to Spence’s (1975) effect related to the shape of total market demand. Our approach also allows us to analyze the effects of commodity taxation and technology shocks on the equilibrium allocation when firms compete in prices and qualities. (JEL D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31)
abstract_zh: 本文研究企业在拥有市场势力时的质量扭曲问题。我们构建了一个允许需求函数具有灵活形式的模型，将斯彭斯（1975）的垄断分析拓展至不完全竞争市场。研究表明，质量扭曲由竞争效应决定——该效应捕捉了企业在同时提高价格与质量时对竞争对手产生的外部性，此外还包含斯彭斯（1975）提出的与总市场需求形态相关的效应。我们的方法还允许分析当企业在价格与质量维度展开竞争时，商品税与技术冲击对均衡配置的影响。（JEL分类号：D43, D62, H22, L13, L15, O31）

title_secondary: Multi-Project Collaborations
authors: Charles Angelucci, Roi Orzach
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We analyze collaborative experimentation across multiple independent domains. Each domain contains infinitely many potential projects with asymmetric benefits. In each period and in each domain, two players can idle, jointly explore a new project, or jointly exploit a known one, with voluntary transfers. For intermediate discount factors, treating domains as independent during experimentation is suboptimal. The optimal experimentation policy exhibits common features of collaborative experimentation: lengthy exploration, temporary project exploitation, recall of past projects, and inefficient initial or terminal idling within certain domains. We connect these findings to research on buyer-supplier dynamics and persistent productivity differences.
abstract_zh: 我们分析了跨多个独立领域的协作实验。每个领域包含无限多个具有不对称收益的潜在项目。在每个时期和每个领域，两名参与者可以选择闲置、共同探索新项目或共同利用已知项目，并允许自愿转移。对于中等折现因子，在实验过程中将各领域视为独立是次优的。最优实验策略展现出协作实验的共同特征：长时间的探索、临时性的项目利用、对过往项目的回溯，以及某些领域内低效的初始或终端闲置。我们将这些发现与买方-供应商动态及持续生产率差异的研究联系起来。

title: Geography versus income: The heterogeneous effects of carbon taxation
title_zh: 地理与收入：碳税政策的异质性效应
title_primary: 地理与收入：碳税政策的异质性效应
title_secondary: Geography versus income: The heterogeneous effects of carbon taxation
authors: Charles Labrousse, Yann Perdereau
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-04 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: The distributive effects of carbon taxation are critical for its political acceptability and depend on both income and geographic factors. Using French administrative data, household surveys, and matched employer–employee records, we document that rural households spend 2.8 times more on fossil fuels than urban households and work in firms that emit 2.7 times more greenhouse gases. We incorporate these facts into a spatial heterogeneous-agent model with migration, housing and wealth accumulation, bridging spatial and macroeconomic approaches. Carbon taxes generate 56% larger welfare losses for rural households than for urban households, as the former may be trapped due to mobility frictions and homeownership. While uniform or income-based rebates reduce inequality along the income dimension, they leave large spatial disparities that must be offset through location-based transfers. These results suggest that carbon policies should account for spatial differences to improve political feasibility.

title: Double standards: When stakeholders disagree with spectators in repugnance judgments
title_zh: 双重标准：当利益相关者与旁观者在厌恶判断上产生分歧时
title_primary: 双重标准：当利益相关者与旁观者在厌恶判断上产生分歧时

authors: Hande Erkut, Dorothea Kübler
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Transactions such as kidney sales or surrogacy often evoke repugnance among unaffected observers (spectators). We examine whether individuals directly involved in these transactions (stakeholders) are more accepting. In our lab experiment featuring a transaction with severe consequences and limited agency for the vulnerable party, spectators and vulnerable stakeholders largely deem it repugnant, whereas advantaged stakeholders (who have the right to make offers) are less likely to prohibit it. Spectators and vulnerable stakeholders differentiate between mild and severe outcomes, while advantaged stakeholders are accepting in both cases. All groups are more prohibitive when agency is lacking. Overall, spectators mostly align with the vulnerable, while advantaged stakeholders view the transactions more favorably.
abstract_zh: 诸如肾脏买卖或代孕等交易，往往会在未受影响的旁观者（旁观者）中引发反感。我们考察了直接参与这些交易的个人（利益相关者）是否更为接受。在我们的实验室实验中，涉及后果严重且弱势方代理权有限的交易，旁观者和弱势利益相关者大多认为其令人反感，而优势利益相关者（拥有提出要约权利的一方）则较少倾向于禁止。旁观者和弱势利益相关者会区分轻微与严重后果，而优势利益相关者在两种情况下均持接受态度。当缺乏代理权时，所有群体都更倾向于禁止。总体而言，旁观者主要与弱势方立场一致，而优势利益相关者则对交易持更为积极的态度。

title_zh: 从稻米到责任：中国的集体主义与环境支付意愿
title_primary: 从稻米到责任：中国的集体主义与环境支付意愿
title_secondary: From rice to responsibility: collectivism and environmental willingness to pay in China
authors: Yuxuan Fei, Jie Ma, Qiang Wen, Xiaojun Yang
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-09 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This study investigates how deeply rooted collectivist culture, stemming from historical rice farming practices, shapes individuals’ willingness to pay (WTP) for environmental protection in China. Using data from the China General Social Survey (CGSS), we examine the relationship between the proportion of rice farming in a province – a proxy for collectivism – and stated environmental WTP. Our findings reveal that regions with a higher prevalence of rice farming exhibit a significantly greater environmental WTP, consistent with the hypothesis that collectivism fosters stronger pro-environmental preferences. The effect is strongest among individuals with low intrinsic public spirit, revealing a ‘cultural compensation’ mechanism whereby external norms of shared responsibility substitute for weak internal altruism. It is further amplified in regions facing more severe pollution pressures but weakens in areas with a higher share of migrants from low-collectivism regions, underscoring both the persistence of historical cultural influences. These findings extend the ‘rice theory’ to contemporary environmental behaviour and highlight the enduring role of culture in shaping environmental preferences. For policymakers, this suggests that while collectivist cultural values should be recognized as important contextual factors in environmental policy design, formal environmental policies also play a crucial role in complementing or even substituting the influence of collectivist culture.

title: Hedger of Last Resort: Evidence from Brazilian FX Interventions, Local Credit, and Global Financial Cycles

authors: RODRIGO BARBONE GONZALEZ, DMITRY KHAMETSHIN, JOSÉ‐LUIS PEYDRÓ, ANDREA POLO
official: 官方在线 2026-05-22 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We show that FX interventions can be effective, particularly in attenuating global financial spillovers. We exploit global financial shocks and Brazilian central bank interventions in FX derivatives using three matched administrative registers: bank credit (to firms), foreign credit to banks, and employer‐employees. After the U.S. Taper Tantrum (followed by emerging markets' FX turbulence), Brazilian banks with more foreign debt cut credit supply, reducing firm‐level employment. A subsequent large policy intervention supplying derivatives against FX risks — hedger of last resort — halved the negative effects. A 2008 to 2015 panel exploiting global FX shocks and local FX interventions confirms the results and the hedging channel. However, the FX policy entails fiscal and moral hazard costs.
abstract_zh: 我们证明外汇干预是有效的，尤其是在缓解全球金融溢出效应方面。我们利用全球金融冲击和巴西央行在外汇衍生品领域的干预措施，结合三组匹配的行政登记数据：银行对企业信贷、银行的外国信贷以及雇主-雇员数据。在美国缩减恐慌（随后引发新兴市场外汇动荡）之后，外债较多的巴西银行削减了信贷供给，导致企业层面的就业减少。随后，一项大规模的政策干预——作为最后对冲者提供外汇衍生品以对冲外汇风险——将负面效应减半。利用2008年至2015年面板数据，结合全球外汇冲击与本地外汇干预的分析，进一步证实了上述结果及对冲渠道的作用。然而，外汇政策也带来了财政成本和道德风险成本。

authors: Pooyan Amir‐Ahmadi, Christian Matthes, Mu‐Chun Wang
official: 官方在线 2026-03-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The effects of monetary policy shocks are regularly estimated using high‐frequency surprises in asset prices around central bank meetings as an instrument. These studies, insofar as they explicitly model the relationship between instrument and structural shock, assume a constant relationship between the instrument and the monetary policy shock. By allowing for time variation in this relationship, we show that only a few distinct periods are informative about monetary policy shocks. Therefore, we build a narrative for instrument‐based identification. For the instrument in Gertler and Karadi, the effect on the (log) price level is almost 50% larger than the standard specification would suggest.

title_primary: 言行一致？绿色政治家与污染模式

authors: Michael Koetter, Alexander Popov
official: 官方在线 2025-10-24 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Exploiting three decades of detailed regional data for Germany, we find that when the Green Party is successful at the polls, local hazardous emissions decline. The level of political representation matters, too. Green politicians’ gaining influence at county level is followed largely by a decline in air pollutants that have an immediate adverse health effect. In contrast, when the Green party joins the state government, only greenhouse gas emissions that affect the welfare of future generations via climate change decline. The primary mechanism to achieve lower emissions appears to be a reduction in output, rather than more efficient energy use.
abstract_zh: 利用德国三十年来详尽的区域数据，我们发现当绿党在选举中获胜时，当地有害排放物会减少。政治代表程度同样重要。绿党政客在县级层面获得影响力后，主要伴随的是对健康有直接不利影响的空气污染物减少。相比之下，当绿党加入州政府时，只有通过气候变化影响后代福利的温室气体排放会减少。实现较低排放的主要机制似乎是产出减少，而非能源利用效率提升。
